title: Story Engine
tagline: A branching story where some choices only appear once you carry the right thing, and a page to paste in your own.
readinessNote: The whole story is one JSON list of passages (Story/Source) with four words: goto, gives, requires, and no choices for an ending. Readers can paste their own story on the remix page and play it at once, with mistakes named in plain words.
buildYourOwn: Your own story: passages, choices, things to carry and locked choices.
